Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT TARGET is the supplied Magic Mail building. TWO mismatched small windows at most. Remove every extra tier, long pipe, column, tiny trim, jewelry or pattern. Clean hand-drawn glossy 2D mobile-game map sprite, broad smooth color gradients with only ONE broad highlight per main mass, slim ivory outer outline. At most THREE large architectural masses. Simple charming shapes readable at 120px tall, deliberately REDUCED detail, not a realistic ornate 3D render. ONE complete isolated building on TRUE transparent alpha with ample margins. No shadows, glow haze, background, landscape, people or words.
